messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "may be increased by 20 or 40 mg"
set: ["may be increased by 20 or 40 mg", "dose may be gradually increased", "dose may be increased to 14 mg once daily", "can be increased by 100 mg every 5 days if needed", "may be increased to 20 mg per day after one week if symptoms are not adequately controlled", "dose prescribed by your doctor may be used", "dose may be increased to 20 mg once a day after at least 3 weeks of treatment if necessary", "40 mg of primary drug", "40 mg every 12 weeks", "if the diuretic response to the initial dose is not satisfactory, the dose may be increased by 1 or 2 mg/kg", "may be taken with or without food", "if satisfactory response does not occur within one hour, dose may be increased to 80 mg", "stopping suddenly may cause increased seizures or withdrawal symptoms", "12.5 mg dose may be sufficient for many patients", "dose adjustments or alternative treatments may be available", "dose should be increased to 75 mg/day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
